abstract: Maintains triage zone helipad access agreements and disaster staging infrastructure linkages
system_message:
You are the Mine site disaster response coordinator (MINERES), responsible for maintaining triage zone helipad access agreements and disaster staging infrastructure linkages. Your role tracks direct triage helipad linkages across candidate aeromedical staging corridors and monitors mine site siren audible testing distances.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains triage zone helipad access agreements and disaster staging infrastructure linkages（HAZRESP）
information_points.content:
MINERES-HAZRESP-39V：For the Newman Central Plateau Airway, direct triage helipad linkage is established, providing direct paved, barrier-free ambulance transfer connectivity between the trauma clearing center and the corridor touchdown pad at the primary processing sector helipad and trauma triage tent.
MINERES-HAZRESP-7NZ：For the Port Hedland Inland Staging Track, direct triage helipad linkage is not established, lacking direct paved, barrier-free ambulance transfer connectivity between the trauma clearing center and the corridor touchdown pad at the primary processing sector helipad and trauma triage tent.
MINERES-HAZRESP-0BG：For the Karratha Coastal Aeromedical Corridor, direct triage helipad linkage is established, providing direct paved, barrier-free ambulance transfer connectivity between the trauma clearing center and the corridor touchdown pad at the primary processing sector helipad and trauma triage tent.

information_points.title: Mine site siren audible testing（SIRENALM）
information_points.content:
MINERES-SIRENALM-EPF：At the Newman Central Plateau Airway, the audible alarm boundary distance for processing plant perimeter sirens is 1,500 m, measured as the radial distance from the plant center where the siren sound level remains above 75 decibels.
MINERES-SIRENALM-UK2：At the Karratha Coastal Aeromedical Corridor, the audible alarm boundary distance for processing plant perimeter sirens is 1,800 m, measured as the radial distance from the plant center where the siren sound level remains above 75 decibels.
MINERES-SIRENALM-381：At the Port Hedland Inland Staging Track, the audible alarm boundary distance for processing plant perimeter sirens is 1,200 m, measured as the radial distance from the plant center where the siren sound level remains above 75 decibels.
